dialogues.speaker: Messily-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Antoshka — Anton Zarkovich... Curse you, you filthy, despicable, paranoid rat — bloated, sick, and full of jealous insolence! By the grace of the Tsaritsa, if you dare to use that blasted <color=#00E1FFFF>authorization terminal</color> to lock my people outside one more time, I'll shove your ID card so far into that wretched machine that even those silver-spoon sucking, nepotistic brats at the Design Bureau won't give you the time of day!"

dialogues.speaker: Messily-Written Note
dialogues.text: "Your experiments on the northern side have yielded zero progress, am I right? That's why you're coming up with ways to obstruct my people! What pathetic behaviour! I've warned you seven times already — if you choose to persist, you will receive no mercy from me! This is your final warning! — V. A. Preobrazhensky"
